projects.name: Amazon solar power purchase agreement, Texas
projects.quote: Securing two power purchase agreements at new solar facilities, together • totaling over 600 MW, with two of the world’s leading tech companies – one for 200 MW with Amazon in Texas and one for 405 MW with Microsoft in Illinois.

projects.name: Vistra Vision 15% minority interest acquisition
projects.quote: We were pleased this quarter to announce the pending acquisition of the 15% minority interest in Vistra Vision for a net present value cash purchase price of approximately $3.1 billion 2, which will increase our shareholders’ ownership of our zero-carbonnuclear, energy storage, and solar generation assets, as well as our high-performing retail business.
